name: superflow
description: Production phase-budget workflow with faceted Analyst/Build mindset, Reuse Guard, package validator Ready gates, and TDD contract on code tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Route ideas into issue, PRD, plan, or execution with honest Ready gates.
interface.longDescription: Superflow is a portable Agent Skills plugin that routes raw ideas, GitHub issues, mature PRDs, analyst notes, technical specs, implementation plans, WARLOGs, execution, and QA through the smallest honest phase set. Analyst and Build use a faceted truth contract (Produto/Backend/Frontend/Copy, Recode Log, strings-safadas) with a package validator as the Ready boundary. Plan/Execute/QA enforce TDD I1–I3 on code tasks. Install from the marketplace Git root; do not copy the plugin into product repos.
defaultPrompt: Use Superflow to route this request.
Audit this request with Superflow gaps.
Promote this issue into a Superflow PRD package.
Validate this Superflow package before declaring ready.
